verdict.summary: Round 3's clean result remains valid. The verifier consistently treats only uniquely mapped, bd-migration-labelled issues as authenticated; marker-only decoys and duplicate authenticated mappings fail closed. Planned dependency and parent markers are checked against resolved issue numbers, live omissions fail verification, closed-endpoint omissions are explicitly recorded as moot, and unresolvable edges necessarily coincide with unmigrated authenticated endpoints. The self-tests exercise the real pure verification path across complete, forged, duplicate, incomplete, misdirected, cross-kind, closed, and native-summary cases, including the trust-boundary regression requested in earlier rounds. The CLI keeps verification read-only and rejects simultaneous --apply. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or instruction-injection issue is present.
